customManagers.description: Track vendored libraries that THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md records by release.

packageRules.description: A vendored release needs its sources replaced by hand, so its update is a reminder, never merged as is.
prBodyNotes: This updates only the release recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. Before merging, replace the vendored sources under `vendor/` with that release, and update the commit recorded next to it.
